u0: Initial state: no siren ring has occurred yet, so the switch requirement has not been triggered. Head toward the exit; if the siren starts ringing before arrival, switch to handling it. Reaching the exit while the siren is silent completes the task immediately. Box possession or loss is irrelevant to this RM.
u1: The siren has started ringing and has not yet been toggled in this state. The exit is not accepted while this obligation is pending: go to the wall switch, face it, and toggle it at least once. Reaching the exit before toggling does not complete the task; box handling remains irrelevant.
u2: The post-ring switch-toggle requirement is satisfied: the switch has been toggled at least once after the siren began. The remaining objective is to reach the exit. No further toggle or silent-siren requirement applies, even if the siren rings again, and holding or losing the box does not matter.
u3: Terminal success state: the exit has been reached with the RM conditions met—either no siren ever rang, or the required switch toggle after a ring was completed. The task is finished; no further objective or box handling is required.
